title: Landfall and Summit
author: Bram Oyelaran
blurb: Noor Ashgrove, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
